description:
Scene graph: the hierarchy of nodes (actors and groups) created by the tools. Nodes have stable ids ("n12") and paths
("house/door"); children follow their parent, and every change is undoable through the history toolset.
Workflow: create_group for each object or area -> actors.spawn_actor / build tools with parent -> list_tree or find_nodes
to see what exists -> get_node for transforms and bounds -> move/rotate/scale/reparent/duplicate nodes ->
export_tree / import_tree to save or copy layouts. clear_scope and clear_all checkpoint first, so they can be rolled back.
name: scene

tools.description:
Deletes every node this session created. Creates a checkpoint first. Fails without confirm, or while a history transaction is open.
Returns: Nodes deleted and the checkpoint name (history.rollback restores them).
tools.name: scene.clear_all

returnValue.description: Nodes deleted and the checkpoint name (history.rollback restores them).

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint created first: history.rollback {"name": checkpoint} restores everything. Empty when nothing was deleted.

returnValue.title: RuntimeClearResult

tools.description:
Deletes everything this session created under a node, keeping the node itself. Creates a checkpoint first. Fails without confirm, or while a history transaction is open.
Returns: Nodes deleted and the checkpoint name (history.rollback restores them).

root.description: Scope node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.clear_scope

returnValue.description: Nodes deleted and the checkpoint name (history.rollback restores them).

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint created first: history.rollback {"name": checkpoint} restores everything. Empty when nothing was deleted.

returnValue.title: RuntimeClearResult

tools.description:
Creates an empty group node: a pivot that children move, rotate and scale with. Undoable. The transform is relative to the parent when one is given.
Returns: The new node: {id, name, path, actor}.

location.description: [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

name.description: Group name (made unique among siblings), e.g. "house".

parent.description: Parent node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

rotation.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

tools.name: scene.create_group

returnValue.description: The new node: {id, name, path, actor}.

actor.description: Engine object name of the actor (for actor:Name references).

id.description: Node id, e.g. "n12". Pass it to any tool that takes an actor or a node.

name.description: Node name, unique among its siblings.

path.description: Path through node names from the root, e.g. "house/door" (also accepted wherever a node is expected).

returnValue.title: RuntimeNodeInfo

tools.description:
Deletes a node and its subtree, or only the node with its children moved up to its parent. Undoable.
Returns: The deleted node id and the number of nodes deleted.

promote_children.description: Keep the children and move them to the node's parent.

target.description: Node to delete. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.delete_node

returnValue.description: The deleted node id and the number of nodes deleted.

nodes.description: Nodes deleted (1 with promote_children, else the subtree size).

returnValue.title: RuntimeDeleteNodeResult

tools.description:
Copies a node and its subtree (rebuilt from their spawn recipes) next to the original, as one undo step. Fails for subtrees over 2000 nodes.
Returns: The copy's root node and the number of nodes copied.

name.description: Name for the copy (default: the original's name, made unique).

offset.description: World offset for the copy [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Node to copy. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.duplicate_node

returnValue.description: The copy's root node and the number of nodes copied.

id.description: Id of the copy's root node.

returnValue.title: RuntimeDuplicateResult

tools.description:
Exports nodes as a JSON spec (transforms relative to the parent, spawn recipes, tags, colors) for import_tree.
Returns: {nodes:[{id, name, source, location, rotation, scale, tags, color, children:[...]}]}.

root.description: Export only this subtree (default: all root nodes). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.export_tree

returnValue.description: {nodes:[{id, name, source, location, rotation, scale, tags, color, children:[...]}]}.

tools.description:
Finds nodes by name, tag or kind, optionally below one node.
Returns: Total match count and the nodes {id, name, path, kind, tags} in tree order.

pattern.description: Name filter: a wildcard ("door*") or a case-insensitive substring.

under.description: Search only below this node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.find_nodes

returnValue.description: Total match count and the nodes {id, name, path, kind, tags} in tree order.

nodes.description: Matches in tree order (pre-order), at most `limit`.

total.description: Number of matching nodes (may exceed the list).

returnValue.title: RuntimeNodeList

tools.description: Returns one node: hierarchy, tags, class, source, world transform, bounds (including children) and shape color. Fails if the target is not a live scene node (deleted nodes come back with history.undo).

target.description: Node id or path, e.g. "n12" or "house/door". (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.get_node

color.description: Shape color [r, g, b] set by spawn_actor (empty if none).

tools.description:
Builds nodes from an export_tree spec as one undo step. Fails on invalid specs or more than 2000 nodes.
Returns: New root ids, the node count and spec id -> new id.

parent.description: Attach the imported roots under this node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tree.description: Spec {nodes:[{name, source, location, rotation, scale, tags, color, children:[...]}]}, e.g. from export_tree. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: scene.import_tree

returnValue.description: New root ids, the node count and spec id -> new id.

id_map.description: Spec id -> new node id (for specs that carry ids, up to 200 entries).

roots.description: Ids of the imported root nodes, in spec order.

returnValue.title: RuntimeImportResult

tools.description:
Returns the node hierarchy, depth-limited. Nodes at the depth limit report child_count instead of children.
Returns: Nested nodes in tree order, the total live node count and whether the limit cut the tree.

fields.description: Node fields to include besides id: name, path, kind, parent, tags, class, source, location, rotation, scale, bounds (default name and kind).

root.description: Start node (default: all root nodes). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.list_tree

returnValue.description: Nested nodes in tree order, the total live node count and whether the limit cut the tree.

nodes.description: Nested nodes [{id, <fields>, children:[...]}]; nodes at the depth limit show child_count instead of children. (Any JSON value)

total_nodes.description: Live nodes in the whole scene graph.

truncated.description: True when the node limit cut the tree short.

returnValue.title: RuntimeTreeResult

tools.description:
Moves a node to a location or by an offset (give exactly one). Children follow. Undoable.
Returns: The node's resulting world transform.

location.description: New location [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

offset.description: Offset to add [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

space.description: World; or Local: location relative to the parent node, offset along the node's own axes.

target.description: Node to move. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.move_node

target.description: The changed actor (node id or actor:Name).

warning.description: Set when the change has a side effect worth knowing (e.g. shearing children).

tools.description:
Renames a node. The id stays the same; the path changes. Undoable. Fails if a sibling already has the name.
Returns: The node with its new name and path.

name.description: New name, e.g. "front_door" ("/" is replaced by "_").

target.description: Node to rename. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.rename_node

returnValue.description: The node with its new name and path.

actor.description: Engine object name of the actor (for actor:Name references).

id.description: Node id, e.g. "n12". Pass it to any tool that takes an actor or a node.

name.description: Node name, unique among its siblings.

path.description: Path through node names from the root, e.g. "house/door" (also accepted wherever a node is expected).

returnValue.title: RuntimeNodeInfo

tools.description:
Moves a node under another node, or to the root when parent is omitted. Undoable. Fails if the new parent is the node itself or one of its descendants.
Returns: The node with its new path.

keep_world.description: Keep the world transform (false keeps the relative transform).

parent.description: New parent node; omit (or "") for the root. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

target.description: Node to move. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.reparent_node

returnValue.description: The node with its new path.

actor.description: Engine object name of the actor (for actor:Name references).

id.description: Node id, e.g. "n12". Pass it to any tool that takes an actor or a node.

name.description: Node name, unique among its siblings.

path.description: Path through node names from the root, e.g. "house/door" (also accepted wherever a node is expected).

returnValue.title: RuntimeNodeInfo

tools.description:
Sets a node's rotation or applies a rotation delta (give exactly one). Children follow. Undoable.
Returns: The node's resulting world transform.

delta.description: Rotation to apply, e.g. [0, 90, 0] turns 90 degrees around Z. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

rotation.description: New rotation [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

space.description: World; or Local: rotation relative to the parent node, delta about the node's own axes.

target.description: Node to rotate. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.rotate_node

target.description: The changed actor (node id or actor:Name).

warning.description: Set when the change has a side effect worth knowing (e.g. shearing children).

tools.description:
Sets a node's world scale or multiplies it by a factor (give one). Undoable. Prefer scaling leaves: non-uniform scale on a parent shears rotated children (the result then carries a warning). Fails on zero scale components.
Returns: The node's resulting world transform.

factor.description: Multiply the current scale, e.g. [2, 2, 2]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

scale.description: New world scale [x, y, z]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Node to scale. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.scale_node

target.description: The changed actor (node id or actor:Name).

warning.description: Set when the change has a side effect worth knowing (e.g. shearing children).

tools.description:
Sets, adds or removes node tags (also applied as actor tags). Undoable.
Returns: The node's tags after the change.

target.description: Node to tag. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.set_node_tags

returnValue.description: The node's tags after the change.

tags.description: The node's tags after the change.

returnValue.title: RuntimeTagsResult

tools.description:
Moves a group's origin while its children stay where they are. Undoable. Fails if the target is not a group.
Returns: The group and its new pivot location.

location.description: New pivot [x, y, z] in world cm (default: the center of the children's bounds). ([x, y, z] (cm))

target.description: Group node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: scene.set_pivot

returnValue.description: The group and its new pivot location.
returnValue.title: RuntimePivotResult
